data: Is the accuracy of the model at epoch 10 higher than the accuracy at epoch 0?

The top graph shows the accuracy of the entire development set of FDCL18. At epoch 0, the accuracy is approximately 0.81. At epoch 10, the accuracy is approximately 0.79. Therefore, the accuracy at epoch 10 is lower than the accuracy at epoch 0.
